title: 34% of Developers in 2026 GDC Survey Were Laid Off in Last 2 Years
content:
The Game Developers Conference (GDC) released the results of its 15th annual "State of the Game Industry Survey" last Thursday and revealed that 34% of game developers surveyed were laid off in the last 24 months, up from 28% last year. Of that 34%, 68% stated they were laid off in the last 12 months. 49% of those surveyed reported that their company conducted layoffs in some form in the past 12 months.

54% of those laid off have not found new employment. Of those who have found new employment, 9% of have left the game industry, while 4% have their own game industry companies.

40% of game developers report using generative AI in their work, with 57% of those stating they use it daily. However, usage remains polarizing, with 55% of developers saying it has a negative impact on games. Mobile-only developers and developers working on free-to-play games report the highest usage at 70% and 58%, respectively. 27% of workers from AAA studios report being encouraged or pressured to use generative AI, with only 9% of indie studio workers reporting the same.

The survey noted of those who use AI tools as part of their job, 38% from the U.S. stated they did, and 44% outside of the U.S. stated they did.

35% of developers are using Unreal Engine to develop their game, being the most popular engine among respondents, but down from 42% last year. Unity is the second most popular engine, with 28% of developers using the engine, down from 30% last year. 23% of developers report using proprietary or in-house engines.

86% of responses report more fulfilment working in the game industry compared to other industries, though 86% of developers also report working more than 40 hours in a single week over the past year, with 46% reporting working more than 40 hours a week on average. 66% of respondents see working in the game industry as part of their identity and self-worth. 65% say their mental health has suffered due to their game industry job, but only looking at those who are currently unemployed, the percentage jumps to 81%.

80% of respondents in the United States support unionization of game industry workers, while 55% are interested in joining a union. 20% are not currently in a union and are not seeking to join one.

81% of developers are working on games for the PC, with 45% developing for PlayStation 5, 37% developing for Xbox Series X|S, 32% developing for Steam Deck, and 29% developing for Nintendo Switch 2 (overlap can exist as games often release on multiple platforms). 10% of respondents are developing games for the upcoming next generation PlayStation console, while 8% are developing for Xbox's upcoming "Project Helix" device.

46% of developers report an interest in developing for the Switch 2, up from 37% last year, while 38% report interest in developing games built for the Steam Deck (games developer for Steam Deck are also PC games by definition).

The survey asked more than 2,600 game developers about their work and about the industry. 63% of respondents live in the United States, and 3% live in Japan.

The Game Developers Conference will be held at the Moscone Convention Center in San Francisco from March 1 through March 4.

title: The Summer Hikaru Died Novels End With 3rd Volume
content:
Yen Press is releasing the novels in English, and it describes the story:

The bond between Yoshiki and Hikaru is a welcome escape from their isolated village. But one day when the two boys meet up, Yoshiki can immediately tell something is off. Though the person standing before him looks and acts exactly like Hikaru, Yoshiki knows that his friend is... gone. Someone―no, something has taken Hikaru's place. And with so many eerie incidents happening in town lately, Yoshiki is becoming increasingly conflicted. Although things will never be as they once were, he would prefer this Hikaru to no Hikaru at all.

Nukaga launched the novel series with the first volume in December 2023. The second volume shipped in Japan in July 2025. Yen Press released the first novel volume in English in April 2025.

Mokumokuren launched the manga on Kadokawa 's Young Ace Up website in August 2021, and ended it on October 20. Kadokawa published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on June 4, and will publish the 10th and final volume on January 25. The manga exceeded 3 million copies in circulation by the time of the sixth volume's release.

Yen Press publishes the manga in English, and released the manga's eighth volume on October 27.

The manga was nominated for the 16th Manga Taisho Awards. (The official English name of the awards is the "Cartoon Grand Prize.") The New York Public Library listed the manga as part of its Best Books list for teens in 2023. The manga also made The American Library Association's (ALA's) Young Adult Library Services Association (YALSA) 2024 list of Great Graphic Novels for Teens.

Both the manga and its author Mokumokuren were nominated for the Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards in 2024. The manga was nominated for the Best U.S. Edition of International Material—Asia category, while Mokumokuren was nominated for the Best Writer/Artist category.

The manga's anime adaptation debuted in July 2025. The anime will have a second season.

The manga also inspired a stage play adaptation that ran from January 9-18 at Kinokuniya Hall in Tokyo.

title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Unveils Main Visual
content:
A main visual was unveiled for the upcoming Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? anime. Studio SynergySP is animating the series with Yasuaki Fujii as director. It is set to premiere on January 7, 2027.

A teaser trailer was previously released. Keiichiro Ochi is in charge of the series composition while Majiro is on character designs, and Alisa Okehazama is composing the music. The main voice cast consists of:

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Mai Chihara

• Kazuki Ura as Kuroki

• Maaya Uchida as Chinatsu Iwakura

• Tomokazu Sugita as Hibiya

• Daisuke Ono as Kazami

Ryon launched the manga on Comic Smart’s Ganma! website in June 2021 and currently has 8 volumes in circulation. Seven Seas will release the mang in English on September 29, 2026. They describe it as follows: Don’t judge a book by its cover or a girl by her fashion taste! A slice-of-life rom-com manga about wrong impressions and looking beyond appearances. The manga that inspired the upcoming anime It’s the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a “landmine” girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara’s attention, he discovers she isn’t nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl… if a little weird. Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise?

title: Skip and Loafer Season 2 Reveals New Key Visual, New Trailer
content:
The previously announced Skip and Loafer Season 2 revealed a key visual and a new trailer on Monday. Additionally, Reina Ueda and Yuto Takenaka will join the voice cast as Chieri Yasaka and Kiyohiko Ujiie, respectively. Studio P.A. Works will continue to animate the series, set to premiere in April 2027.

The cast will reprise their roles:

• Tomoyo Kurosawa as Mitsumi Iwakura

• Akinori Egoshi as Sosuke Shima

• Maaya Uchida as Yuzuki Marashige

• Yuka Terasaki as Mika Egashira

• Megumi Han as Makoto Kurume

• Mitsuki Saiga as Nao-chan

• Hikaru Tanaka as Mukai Tsukasa

• Ayumu Murase as Kento Yamada

Kotomi Deai will once again serve as both director and series composition writer while Manami Umeshita return as character designer. Yoko Yonaiyama, who contributed to the scripts for several episodes in the first season, will collaborate with Deai on the series composition.

Misaki Takamatsu writes and draws the Skip and Loafer manga, which has been serialized in Kodansha’s Afternoon magazine since 2018. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English, while Crunchyroll is streaming the anime. The story follows the country girl Mitsumi, as she joins a prestigious school in Tokyo and gets struck with the city life. She meets the handsome but aloof Sosuke, and she slowly gets used to the new life while building a relationship with him and her classmates.

title: Märchen Crown Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
This year's 50th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine announced on Thursday Aka Akasaka , Aoi Kujira , and Ajichika 's Märchen Crown manga will end in the next issue on November 19.

The manga debuted in Young Jump in March 2025. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Rapunzel is a young girl who lives atop a tall tower and knows nothing of the outside world. One day she meets a boy named Mikel, who climbs the tower, and their destiny to change the world begins to unfold! The creators of " Oshi no Ko " and " Record of Ragnarok " form an incredible team to bring you the ultimate love story!

Akasaka ( Oshi no Ko ), is writing the story, Kujira ( Geek Circle Crisis ) is composing the series' story, and Record of Ragnarok artist Ajichika is drawing the series. Shueisha published the manga's fifth compiled volume on October 19.

Akasaka ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) and Mengo Yokoyari ( Scum's Wish ) launched the Oshi no Ko manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump magazine in April 2020, and ended it in November 2024. The manga's 16th and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan in December 2024. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service released the manga in English digitally. Yen Press licensed the manga for print release.

The television anime adaptation premiered in Japan in April 2023 with a 90-minute first episode. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and it is also streaming an English dub . The company stated that the anime became the streaming service's "#1 series launch in the streamer's history." The anime's second season premiered in July 2024 on Tokyo MX and over 29 other channels throughout Japan. The anime also streamed simultaneously on the ABEMA service in Japan. HIDIVE streams the anime's English dub . The anime's third season debuted on January 14. Crunchyroll and HIDIVE both streamed the season. The anime will have a fourth season, which will be the final season.
author: ANN

title: 'Skip to Loafer 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, First Promo
content:
• The official website for the Skip to Loafer ( Skip and Loafer ) television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, new key visual, and the first promotional video for the Season 2 on Monday. The second season adapting Misaki Takamatsu 's coming-of-age manga will premiere in April 2027.

Voice actresses Reina Ueda ( Mao ) and Yuuto Takenaka ( Saijo no Osewa ) are joining in the anime as Chieri Yasaka and Kiyohiko Ujiie, respectively.

Kotomi Deai ( Natsume Yuujinchou Go ) is directing the anime at P.A.Works . Kotomi Deai and Youko Yonaiyama ( Yubisaki to Renren ) are handling the series composition. Manami Umeshita ( Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku sub character design) is designing the characters. Michiru ( Given ) and Takatsugu Wakabayashi ( Otonari ni Ginga ) are composing the music.

The first season aired in 12 episodes in Spring 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Takamatsu began drawing the manga series in Monthly Afternoon in August 2018. Kodansha published the 13th volume on April 23, with the 14th volume scheduled to be released on November 20.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in February 2021 and released the 12th volume on July 7. The 13th volume is scheduled to be released in March 2027.

title: Skip & Loafer Anime's 2nd Season Reveals More Cast in 1st Promo Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of Misaki Takamatsu 's Skip and Loafer ( Skip to Loafer ) manga revealed the first promotional video and more cast on Monday for the anime's second season .

The new cast includes two classmates of Mitsumi as a second-year student:

The website also revealed the new season's first key visual.

Kotomi Deai ( Natsume's Book of Friends ) returns from the first season to direct and oversee the series scripts at P.A. Works . Scriptwriter on the first season Yōko Yonaiyama is also overseeing the series scripts alongside Deai. Manami Umeshita ( Stella Women's Academy , High School Division Class C3 ) is returning as the character designer and chief animation director. Reina Igawa is also returning as another chief animation director, and Yūsuke Inoue is returning from animation director on the first season as another chief animation director. Takatsugu Wakabayashi ( Dragonar Academy ) is returning to compose the music with new composer MICHIRU .

Other staff members on the second season include:

• Sub-Character Design: Mio Fujishima (new)

• Main Animators: Sara Sakoe, Hiroyuki Honda (new), Chieko Satō (new)

• Prop Setting: Satomi Higuchi

• 2D Design, Subtitle Design: Ryo Murakami (new)

• Special Effects: Masahiro Murakami (new), Sumie Murakami (new)

• Background Art: Yūta Fujii

• Art Director: Sō Senoo (new)

• Color Design: Yūko Kobari

• Director of Photography: Akane Ueda (Kazuto Izumita was previously listed in this role)

• 3D Director: Motonari Ichikawa

• Editing: Ayumu Takahashi

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

Junichi Higashi was previously listed as art supervisor but is no longer listed in the staff.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga digitally and in print in English, and it describes the story:

Excellent student Iwakura Mitsumi has always dreamt about leaving her small town, going to a prestigious university, and making positive change in the world. But she's so focused on reaching her goals that she's not prepared for the very different (and overwhelming) city life that awaits her in a Tokyo high school. Luckily, she makes fast friends with Shima Sousuke, a handsome classmate who's as laid-back as she is over-prepared. Can this naive country girl make it big in Tokyo with Sousuke by her side?

The first anime series premiered in April 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

Takamatsu launched the manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Afternoon magazine in August 2018.

The manga ranked #7 in manga for male readers in the 2020 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook. It was nominated in the 13th Manga Taisho awards in 2020, and was also nominated in the Best General Manga category of Kodansha 's 44th annual Manga Awards in 2020.

The manga received a stage musical adaptation that ran in March 2026 in Tokyo and Osaka.

title: Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu TV Anime Debuts on January 6
content:
The official website for the anime of Sanrio 's Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu project announced on Monday the anime will debut on Tokyo MX on January 6, 2027, and will air on Wednesdays at 9:54 p.m. JST.

Gaku Kinoshita ( Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi , Sumikko Gurashi: Koko ga Ochitsukun Desu ) is directing the anime at Fanworks , and Rieko Ebisu is writing the scripts. Midori Shimada is the art director.

The anime was first announced in January 2024.

The project has various goods, pop-up stores, and other collaborative items featuring the Touken Ranbu characters as redesigned by Sanrio .

The Touken Ranbu "sword personification training game" takes famous swords from Japanese history and interprets them as bishōnen . Nitroplus designed the characters and scenario. The game launched in Japan in January 2015.

The franchise has inspired the Katsugeki: Touken Ranbu television anime series and a planned upcoming anime film, as well as the Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru spinoff's two anime series, an anime film trilogy , and a compilation anime film. The franchise has also inspired two live-action films, a long-running stage musical series, a series of stage plays (separate from the stage musical versions), as well as various manga. The franchise had its first ever ice show in October.

Touken Ranbu Kai: Kyoden Moyuru Honnōji is the anime adaptation of the Touken Ranbu Kyoden Moyuru Honnōji stage play. The eight-episode anime premiered in April 2024. Touken Ranbu Kai -Dо̄den Chikashi Haberau Monora- , the prequel to the Touken Ranbu Kai: Kyoden Moyuru Honnōji anime, opened in a three-week limited engagement in Japan in August 2024.

Johren released the original Touken Ranbu browser game in English in April 2021, and released the smartphone version of the game in August 2021. Johren shut down the game's English and Chinese versions in August 2023.

The Touken Ranbu "sword personification training game" takes famous swords from Japanese history and interprets them as bishōnen . Nitroplus designed the characters and scenario. The game launched in Japan in January 2015.

The franchise has inspired the Katsugeki: Touken Ranbu television anime series and a planned upcoming anime film, as well as the Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru spinoff's two anime series, an anime film trilogy , and a compilation anime film. The franchise has also inspired two live-action films, a long-running stage musical series, a series of stage plays (separate from the stage musical versions), as well as various manga. The franchise had its first ever ice show in October.

title: 'Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu' Reveals Main Staff, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website of the Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu television anime revealed the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series, based on the character project designed and produced by Sanrio for the Touken Ranbu Online game, will premiere on January 6 at 9:54 p.m. on Tokyo MX.

Staff Director: Gaku Kinoshita ( Sumikko Gurashi ) Script: Rieko Ebisu Art Director: Midori Shimada Studio: Fanworks

The original Touken Ranbu Online game has received adaptations in various media, including manga, television anime, and live-action films. The Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru manga, illustrated by Saru Hashino , was serialized on the Shounen Jump+ platform from December 2016 to April 2019. Shueisha published the fifth and final volume in June 2019.

• The Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru television anime, produced by Doga Kobo , aired for 12 episodes in Fall 2016. Its sequel, Zoku Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru ( Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru 2 ), followed with another 12-episodes in Winter 2018. The series was later concluded with the three-part theatrical project Toku: Touken Ranbu - Hanamaru - Setsugetsuka ( Touken Ranbu - Hanamaru Season 3 ), which screened in Japan on May 20, July 8, and September 1, 2022.

Other anime projects based on the game include Katsugeki/Touken Ranbu , produced by ufotable and first broadcast in Summer 2017. Touken Ranbu Kai: Kyoden Moyuru Honnouji , a new television anime based on the first stage play in the franchise, which aired in Spring 2024.

The Touken Ranbu live-action film premiered in Japanese theaters in January 2019. Its sequel, Touken Ranbu 2 , opened in Japanese theaters in March 2023.

The franchise has continued to expand into other forms of entertainment, with the official Touken Ranbu - ICE BLADE - ice show holding performances on October 3.

title: Black Witch Mirror Manga to End in 4th Volume
content:
Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Yonan Togawa 's Black Witch Mirror ( Kokufu Kyōdan ) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 15, 2027.

Titan Manga publishes the series in English and describes the story:

In a world where mirrors are more than simple reflections, they serve as gateways to something far more dangerous. A young girl's quiet life begins to fracture when she encounters a mysterious witch, one who doesn't just see through mirrors, but manipulates what lies within them. As strange occurrences ripple through her town, reality itself seems to blur, and the line between memory and illusion becomes dangerously thin. Each reflection reveals fragments of hidden truths: forgotten pasts, suppressed desires, and unsettling possibilities. But the deeper she is drawn into this mirrored world, the more she risks losing her sense of self entirely.

Togawa started Black Witch Mirror as a short mini-series in Vol. 101 of Kadokawa 's Harta magazine in February 2023. The full series then launched in Kadokawa 's Harta Alternative web magazine in October 2023. Kadokawa shipped the third compiled book volume on April 15. Titan Manga will ship the first volume in English on December 15.
author: ANN
